subject: A Level Chemistry
title: Zinc and copper cell
question:
Fig. 6.1 shows an electrochemical cell set up under standard conditions.
Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Zn   E° = −0.76 V
Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu   E° = +0.34 V
(a) Calculate the standard cell potential.
(b) State the direction of electron flow in the external circuit.
(c) State the purpose of the salt bridge.

scene: The salt bridge is a thick line with rounded corners dipping into both solutions.

figure:
An electrochemical cell, side view.
Left beaker: a zinc electrode in 1.0 mol dm⁻³ ZnSO₄(aq). Right beaker: a copper electrode in 1.0 mol dm⁻³ CuSO₄(aq).
A salt bridge, an upside down U shaped tube, dips into both solutions.
Wires from the tops of the two electrodes join through a voltmeter, a circle with V, placed above the middle.
Label: zinc, copper, salt bridge, and the two solutions with their concentrations.
Caption: Fig. 6.1.
